'Kanata kara' Unveils Main Cast, Staff, Teaser Promo for Fall 2026
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kyouko Hikawa's Kanata kara (From Far Away) manga unveiled the main cast, staff, teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video on Wednesday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on Tokyo MX at 12:00 a.m. on October 5, followed by broadcasts on ABC TV and WOWOW. Manga 'Toratsugumi: Tsugumi Project' Receives TV Anime Adaptation
Production company NBCUniversal Entertainment Japan opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of ippatu's Toratsugumi: Tsugumi Project manga on Tuesday, revealing a teaser visual (pictured) and teaser promotional video. Ippatu originally published the action survival manga in France through publisher Ki-oon in July 2019.
